Use your image generation tool. Attach these reference images to the generation: `ref_front.png` (side view, faces right) and `try1/keys_2x2.png` (top-left cell = the same creature seen straight from the front, with both eyes). Save the result exactly as `out/sw_single.png` (overwrite it). Do not write or modify any other file. Reply with the path and image size.

## Prompt (south-west single, retry)

Create a single ultra-crisp 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art sprite (1376x768) on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF) of the same creature as the top-left cell of `try1/keys_2x2.png`: a single rigid green cocoon shell shaped like a pointed bean (bright leaf green #83C54A plates with lime highlights #B4E652, thin dark green seams #394A41, dull sage-green belly area #6A8B5A on the front), a pointed top, two narrow sleepy eyes (white slit with a heavy dark lid), and a short segmented bottom tip (3 to 4 ring segments) that curls forward and rests on the ground. NO legs, NO arms, NO wings, NO antennae, no mouth. Do not add or remove any part.

View: SOUTH-WEST 3/4 quarter view — EXACTLY halfway between the front view (top-left cell of try1/keys_2x2.png) and a left side profile. This is NOT a side profile: BOTH eyes must be visible (the left eye near the left edge of the shell, the right eye smaller and closer to the centre), the sage belly area is seen from the front-left and is wide (about half the shell width), the pointed top leans slightly to the left, the segmented bottom tip curls toward the viewer and to the lower-left. Same size and pixel density as the cells of try1/keys_2x2.png. Crisp 1-2px dark outline, limited palette, no anti-aliasing.
